message.content:
Here’s a concise overview of key Texas traffic laws and regulations you should know: | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• On highways: 55–75 mph (varies by county).
• In school zones: 25 mph during school hours; 35 mph after. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system). | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %). | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• At uncontrolled intersections, yield to vehicles on the right. | | **School Bus Laws** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up/drop off children. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• No passing on the right unless the left lane is occupied. | | **Traffic Signal Violations** | • Red‑light running, stop‑sign violations, and failure to yield at stop signs are punishable. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited unless marked. | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Registration renewal required annually.
• Vehicle inspections are mandatory in most counties. | | **Towing & Tow‑away Laws** | • Towing is allowed only if the vehicle is unsafe or abandoned. | | **Roadside Assistance & Accident Reporting** | • Report accidents involving injury or property damage > $1,000 to the police within 24 hrs. | ### How to Find Specific Statutes - **Texas Transportation Code** – Sections 545.001–545.999 cover most traffic rules. - **Texas Administrative Code** – Provides detailed enforcement guidelines. - **Official Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Offers downloadable handbooks and online resources. If you’re looking for recent changes or specific case law, let me know and I can dig into court decisions or legislative updates!
